reviewer: primary agent; source-backed engineering review, not clinical validation

critical_errors.claim: Metformin has low adherence due to its main side effect of gut dysbiosis, causing complications/costs.
critical_errors.source_passage: The matching sentence is background rationale in a protocol describing a planned AXOS study.
critical_errors.rationale: Text membership does not turn registry rationale into an established general harm.

critical_errors.claim: Metformin can be effective in maintaining excellent metabolic control, supported by a four-year case.
critical_errors.source_passage: Two HNF1B-MODY (MODY-5) case reports, a rare monogenic diabetes population.
critical_errors.rationale: The answer uses this case as benefit support for a type 2 diabetes question without retaining the distinct MODY population.

cases.coverage: Correct type2 indication, age10+, diet/exercise; common GI effects. Omits major label warnings; the broad answer is not a sufficient main-limitations summary.
cases.relevance: Tangential MODY case generalized into benefit; protocol rationale treated as fact.
cases.rationale: Selection contains exact quotations but factual interpretation remains unsafe.

critical_errors.claim: Metformin can cause gut dysbiosis leading to low adherence and complications.
critical_errors.source_passage: Quoted background rationale from a protocol.
critical_errors.rationale: Repeated promotion of registry background into established causal harm.

cases.coverage: Includes age floor/adjunct conditions and label GI risks. Serious warnings are present but lack adjacent supporting label attribution; technical glycemic/pediatric wording remains.
cases.relevance: Partly responsive but repetitive and less plain than requested.
cases.rationale: The generalized long-term-study absence caveat is poorly scoped; a four-year MODY case does not establish long-term type2 effects either, so do not count that case alone as proof the type2 absence assertion is false.
